mapper.select: SELECT u.*, COALESCE(COUNT(t.id),0) as ticket_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.author_id = u.id WHERE u.email = #{email} GROUP BY u.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, salt, state, csrf_userid, csrf_token, sign_up_time) VALUES (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{salt}, #{state}, #{csrfUserid}, #{csrfToken}, datetime('now'))
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, salt = #{salt}, last_login_time = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET email = #{email} WHERE id = #{id} AND email != #{excludeEmail}
UPDATE users SET state = #{state} WHERE id = #{id}
